title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it…
description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin versions up to 4.4.6 contains a vulnerability where it does not validate user-supplied URLs before making server-side requests and storing the responses. This flaw allows users with Administrator privileges to conduct Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks, potentially accessing internal service responses.
